vulnerabilities.name: apache-struts-cve-2017-5638
vulnerabilities.description: Apache Struts2 Jakarta Multipart parser RCE (CVE-2017-5638) -- the Equifax web foothold. Put this on a Tomcat/JRE host (e.g. tomcat:8-jre8) so the showcase WAR is actually served on :8080.
lines: # CVE-2017-5638 -- Apache Struts2 Jakarta Multipart parser RCE (Equifax initial foothold).

vulnerabilities.name: weak-ssh-credentials
vulnerabilities.description: SSH with root login and a weak/reused password (root:equifax) -- the Equifax lateral-movement vector. Put this on a host that also runs sshd.
lines: # Weak/reused SSH credentials -- the lateral-movement vector after the Struts RCE (Equifax).
